Explanation:- For the second sentence of this hadith, some of the scholars have explained, “All the sins of the Mu'adhdhin that occurred in the areas between the place where the Mu'adhdhin calls the Adhan and as far as the sound of the Adhan reaches are forgiven”, and some others have explained, “The sins of those living in the areas as far as the sound of the Mu'adhdhin's Adhan reaches will be forgiven through the Mu'adhdhin's intercession.”
(Badhl-ul-Majhud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: اَلْمُؤَذِّنُونَ أَطْوَلُ النَّاسِ أَعْنَاقاً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب فضل الاذان...، رقم: ٨٥٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Mu'awiyah (RA) narrates that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, “On the Day of Qiyamah the Mu'adhdhin will have a longer neck than everyone.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The scholars have given several meanings for this hadith. One of them is that people hear the sound of the Mu'adhdhin's Adhan and come to the masjid to pray. The one praying becomes a follower, and the Mu'adhdhin becomes the foremost (the origin); the one who is foremost is a leader. Therefore his neck will be raised so that his head can be seen by all.
The second meaning: The Mu'adhdhin will receive abundant reward. In his eagerness at having received his abundant rewards, he will raise his neck again and again to look. Therefore his neck will appear long.
The third meaning: Since the Mu'adhdhin will not suffer regret on account of his deeds, his neck will be long. The neck of one who suffers regret will be lowered.
The fourth meaning: The meaning of the neck being long is that on the plain of Mahshar the Mu'adhdhin
